prompt: Handheld television documentary footage, shoulder camera, natural daylight, slight camera sway, photoreal. The scene is exactly as in the image: a man with his face painted half green and half gold, alone in a vast empty stadium stand, eating a sandwich wrapped in foil. Nobody speaks. He finishes his bite, lowers the sandwich a little and chews slowly with his mouth closed, completely at ease. He glances calmly to one side along the empty rows, then looks back at the camera and keeps chewing, unhurried, as if nothing is unusual. He stays in his seat the whole time. He is the only person in the stadium: nobody else ever enters the frame. Audio: wind in an empty stadium, the foil crinkling once, a far-off bird; quiet, no voices. No music. No laugh track. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no logos.
